name: High income
special_notes:
For FY27 (July 1, 2026–June 30, 2027), income groups are defined using 2025 GNI per capita (Atlas method): low income (LIC) ($1,175 or less); lower middle income (LMC) ($1,176–$4,635); upper middle income (UMC) ($4,636–$14,375); and high income (HIC) (above $14,375).
“Low- and middle-income (LMY)” economies include low-, lower middle-, and upper middle-income groups, while “middle-income (MIC)” economies include lower middle- and upper middle-income groups.
